core_lesson_learned: Across 3 sessions, 34 paired candidates, 0 GAP_OPEN. The capability-gap > domain-gap lesson (v1) and the industrial-analog ceiling (v2) both hold, but session 3 found the DEEPER wall: SATURATION IS DEEPER THAN THE INDUSTRIAL-ANALOG AXIS. Targeting physics/sensory crafts with NO industrial analog (the v2 OPEN hypothesis) did NOT yield OPEN - all 12 collided to NARROW via two mechanisms: (1) many no-analog crafts ALREADY have research-stage AI on the craft itself (even kodo monkoh incense-listening has 'Smell with Genji' arXiv 2602.02785 CHI-2026; organ voicing has the Ising intonation-number law + DL voicing; knapping has CGAN; marbling has Mathematical-Marbling+NS; cognac-aroma has blend-interaction ML); (2) where the craft is genuinely zero-AI (hedgelaying, solera, nerikoh), the fresh TECHNIQUE-FAMILY always has a sibling foothold (visuo-tactile world-models on robot dough-kneading; Koopman on industrial reactors). Since a USABLE fresh technique is by-definition already demonstrated on some domain, there is essentially NO (fresh-technique x craft) cell empty on BOTH axes. The 'first-mover via fresh technique x under-served craft' thesis is SATURATED at the capability-gap level.

v2_hypothesis_outcome.hypothesis: Physics-bearing crafts with NO industrial analog have no prior technique-application even in a twin -> genuine GAP_OPEN.
v2_hypothesis_outcome.verdict_correlation: PARTIALLY VALIDATED. has_industrial_analog='no' crafts collide LESS (76% at none/very-low AI) than 'partial' (33%). The tag is a real low-penetration signal but insufficient for the absolute-zero OPEN needs.
v2_hypothesis_outcome.honest_application_level_nuance: 3 crafts (hedgelaying pleacher-cut, solera saca-timing, nerikoh consistency-by-feel) have GENUINELY ZERO prior AI on the craft itself = application-level first-mover / timing-edge white space (R12). They are graded GAP_NARROW only because the fresh technique-family is demonstrated on a sibling. If 'first to apply ANY AI to this craft' counts as the win, these are the session-3 wins; if 'method-novel OPEN' is required, none qualify.
